audit.whatIsWrong: diff is 'FAV' but diffRating is '8/10' with a red tone and prose reading 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Teemo carry threat 8.5/10' in two fields. The win rate is 53.16% over 3213 games, the chart hands Garen four of seven stages including every stage from Levels 4-5 onward, and the page's own winCon prose says 'Overall difficulty: 6/10'. carryRating 8.5/10 also contradicts breakdown.carry at 7.5/10 in the same file.
audit.why: Same defect pattern as the Swain entry: the label, the rating, the colour and the prose disagree with each other and with the data. A lane Garen loses for three stages and then wins outright is an even matchup, not an 8/10.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 6/10 to match the page's own winCon figure, carryRating 7.5/10 to match breakdown.carry, tone to the standard even yellow, and both difficulty strings rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 and Late spikes asserted the execute beats him without saying why, and the mirror had already established the actual numbers.
audit.why: The mirror audit settled Demacian Justice as 125/200/275 plus 25/30/35% of the target's missing health, dealt as true damage, on a 120s rank-1 cooldown. Against Teemo, who builds no resistances, the only variable is how low his bar is. That is a stronger and more concrete claim than 'executes a squishy Teemo'.
audit.corrected: Both spikes restated with the mirror's verified execute numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The flagged missing interaction is Toxic Shot applying on-hit poison. Nothing on the page mentioned that the poison ticks for 4 seconds, and — critically — nothing connected that to Perseverance, which the level 4-5 plan tells the player to rely on by 'standing back for 8 seconds'. Move Quick's condition was also unstated: Riot's text says its passive speed persists 'until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret'.
audit.why: Against Teemo, the standard Garen sustain plan does not work. Perseverance only regenerates if Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, and Toxic Shot keeps damaging him each second for 4 seconds after the last attack. A player told to back off and heal will stand there taking poison ticks with the passive switched off. The mirror reached the same conclusion. Move Quick is the other free win: a single connected hit strips his passive move speed, which is what lets him hold his poke spacing.
audit.corrected: Toxic Shot's 4-second poison and its suppression of Perseverance promoted to tldr, focus and mistakes; Move Quick's on-hit condition added to the interaction and all-in fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to buy tenacity and Mercury's Treads 'for his slows'. Mushroom slows are slows, and Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows outright while adding move speed.
audit.why: The mirror put it exactly this way: mushrooms zone Garen, they do not hold him. Tenacity shortens crowd control but the slow is already fully answered by an 8-second, zero-cost basic ability, so spending the itemization slot on it is the wrong read.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] re-pointed to the Q slow-break; the Level 6 spike now states shrooms zone but never hold.

notes: Level chart was already correct against the packet — the only entry in this slice where that was true. The rating block was not: a 53.16% lane where Garen owns every stage from Levels 4-5 was labelled 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10' in red while diff said FAV. Reused the mirror's web-verified Demacian Justice numbers rather than re-researching them. UNVERIFIED and left untouched: the page claims in two places (mid, spikes[2].text) that 'your Q silence still lands through the blind' and that the blind 'only stops autos, not your Q silence'. Decisive Strike's silence rides on Garen's next basic ATTACK, so if Blinding Dart causes that attack to miss the silence would not apply — but neither Riot's text nor the mirror settles it, so I neither edited nor repeated the claim. See questionsForUser: if it is wrong, the level 3-5 trading plan on this page is built on a mechanic that does not exist.
